# Update file magic, E-PM2 1.6

Update file magic for E-PM2 1.6: OE 10 10.

**Category:** platform · **Update file magic:** OE 10 10 · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-PM2 firmware 1.6, build 1600](../firmware/epm2-1600.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md)

Model bytes after OE; the E-PL5 has 10 00. The payload is lane-scrambled and XORed, with a checksum and no signature.
